name: Echoheart Resonance Shard
description: A harmonic shard that stores lingering pulse echoes.
specialEffects: Used in compass relics, resonance instruments, and signal anchors.

steps: Refine raw stock for Echoheart Resonance Shard under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Echoheart Refinery protocol before storage.
